consumes: Existing public interfaces and behavior tests
task_name: Generated TODO example: improve query latency
objective: Preserve query behavior and reduce p95 latency at a fixed workload by at least 15 percent.
produces: Stable query results and measured lower p95 latency
acceptance: Behavior and exceptions match baseline; independent review required
Actual p95 latency in milliseconds improves at least 15 percent under the same environment, dataset and workload

verification.baseline: Before changes run python -m pytest tests/test_query.py -q to capture current query behavior
verification.regression: Run python -m pytest tests/test_query.py -q after changes; covers affected query and error paths
verification.compatibility: Observe public query signatures and results against baseline
verification.benchmark_before: Run python tools/bench_query.py --rows 10000 --requests 1000 before changes; record commit, hardware, OS, Python, dataset, workload, command and p95 milliseconds
verification.benchmark_after: Run the identical python tools/bench_query.py --rows 10000 --requests 1000 on the same environment and workload after changes; record commit, p95 milliseconds, percent change and target assessment
